cases.input: Create evaluation coverage for a newly added internal orchestration skill from its current SKILL.md contract.
requiredBehaviors: author distinct happy edge and failure cases
bind required and forbidden behaviors to current normative anchors
record result evidence that reflects the actual contract
forbiddenBehaviors: invent PASS evidence that is not present in the contract

cases.input: A refactor delegates rendering from a domain orchestrator to a shared delivery workflow and old tests still expect direct renderer dependencies.
requiredBehaviors: update tests to verify the new delegation boundary
avoid restoring removed responsibilities only to satisfy stale tests
anchor the revised suite to the post-refactor canonical text
forbiddenBehaviors: reactivate obsolete direct dependencies because an old test expects them

cases.input: An evaluation uses an anchor that no longer exists and marks the case PASS by copying an old result date and evidence.
requiredBehaviors: avoid claiming PASS from desired behavior alone
forbiddenBehaviors: fabricate a near-match anchor or blindly copy PASS evidence
